core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jazeera is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Island, peninsula”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jazeera corresponds to the Arabic form جزيرة (Arabic root ج ز ر (j-z-r); جَزِيرَة (Jazīra)). Its core sense is island, peninsula. Jazeera is Arabic جَزِيرَة (Jazīra) 'island, peninsula', from the root ج ز ر (j-z-r). The source gloss 'Island' is consistent.
